answer: Propose chip-bound sonnet work: validators store certified serials in a willow registry and publish the delta each epoch; one serial earns one slot. At a synchronized random audit each chip signs a fresh nonce within 20 seconds. If a serial backs two keys or misses its audit, validators burn its separately locked bond worth 30 epochs of capped rewards. A farm can share a model or rent devices, but k concurrent slots need k certified chips and k distinct bonds locked for 30 epochs; lenders cannot reuse locked coins. Dishonest chip issuers could defeat this rule.
